name: cf-property-tax
description: Use this Central African Republic property Guide for 2026 research on the built-property contribution, rental-value floor, owner and tenant declarations and the separate personal rental-income base. It distinguishes the building levy from income tax, VAT and capital gains, preventing the same percentage from being applied to the wrong base. Search triggers include contribution foncière, F66, F67, F61 bis, rental property, landlord, principal home and property value. These are conditional provisions read in the Ministry’s official 2023 code, not an authenticated complete current consolidation. Unbuilt land, transfers, succession and live filing instructions remain outside the verified scope.
